name: Alpha Wolf
description: A massive wolf with gleaming eyes and battle scars. The leader of its pack.

bite.description: A powerful bite that deals extra damage

howl.description: A chilling howl that boosts its defense

name: Goblin Chief
description: A cunning goblin leader adorned with stolen jewelry and wielding a well-crafted sword.

sneak_attack.description: A surprise attack that deals extra damage

rally.description: Rallies its strength for a more powerful attack

name: Skeleton Knight
description: A towering skeleton clad in ancient, rusted armor and wielding a massive greatsword.

name: Flame Demon
description: A larger, more menacing creature of living flame with a core of molten rock.

flame_burst.description: Erupts in flames, dealing fire damage

heat_wave.description: Creates a wave of heat that causes damage over time

name: Troll Berserker
description: An enormous troll with bulging muscles and a perpetual rage. It wields a massive club made from a tree trunk.

smash.description: A powerful smash that deals heavy damage

rage.description: Enters a rage, increasing attack but lowering defense

name: Archmage
description: A powerful human mage with mastery over multiple schools of magic. Dark energy crackles around them.

shadow_bolt.description: Fires a bolt of shadow energy

arcane_barrier.description: Creates a magical barrier that increases defense

name: Broodmother Spider
description: An enormous spider with glowing eyes and dripping venom. Smaller spiders crawl around it.

web.description: Traps you in a sticky web, preventing movement

poison.description: Injects potent venom that causes damage over time

summon_spiderlings.description: Summons small spiders to aid in the attack

name: Bandit Warlord
description: A legendary bandit leader known for ruthless tactics and unmatched combat skills. Wears trophies from fallen enemies.

precise_strike.description: A precise attack that ignores defense

battle_command.description: Uses tactical knowledge to improve combat effectiveness

name: Ancient Golem
description: A colossal golem crafted by a forgotten civilization. Runes of power glow across its stone body.

earthquake.description: Slams the ground, causing a devastating earthquake

stone_skin.description: Hardens its stone body, greatly increasing defense

name: Lich Lord
description: A supremely powerful undead sorcerer who has transcended death. Dark magic swirls around its skeletal form.

soul_drain.description: Drains your life force to heal itself

frost_nova.description: Releases a burst of frost that damages and slows

death_curse.description: Places a curse that causes increasing damage over time
